summary: A progress bar that fills from 0 to 100 percent in steps of 5 every 100 ms when Start upload is clicked.
use: Showing upload or export progress that the app updates as work completes.
spec: `setInterval` runs every `100` ms with `value = Math.min(100, value + 5)` and clears at 100
Percent text `{value}%` shown beside the bar
Button `<Button variant="outlined" size="sm" disabled={running} onclick={start}>` switches label with `{running ? 'Uploading…' : 'Start upload'}`
